query: PromptBench 的核心贡献是什么？
answer: PromptBench 是一个用于评估大语言模型的统一库，包含提示构建、提示工程、数据集与模型加载、对抗提示攻击、动态评估协议和分析工具等关键组件，旨在作为开放、通用且灵活的研究代码库。
support_quote: we introduce PromptBench, a unified library to evaluate LLMs. It consists of several key components that can be easily used and extended by researchers
title: PromptBench: A Unified Library for Evaluation of Large Language Models

query: PromptBench 在提示方面提供了哪些类型和工程方法？
answer: PromptBench 提供 4 种不同的提示类型，用户还可通过 Prompt 接口自定义提示；同时目前包含 6 种主要的提示工程方法。
support_quote: PromptBench offers a suite of 4 distinct prompt types, and additionally, users have the flexibility to craft custom prompts using the Prompt interface.
title: PromptBench: A Unified Library for Evaluation of Large Language Models

query: PromptBench 默认支持哪种评估协议，还额外支持哪些协议？
answer: PromptBench 默认支持标准协议，即直接推理；此外还通过动态生成测试数据支持动态评估协议和语义评估协议。
support_quote: By default, PromptBench supports the standard protocol, i.e., the direct inference. PromptBench further supports dynamic (Zhu et al., 2023a) and semantic (Liu et al., 2023b) evaluation protocols by dynamically generating testing data.
title: PromptBench: A Unified Library for Evaluation of Large Language Models

query: PromptBench 在提示工程评估中得到了什么结果？
answer: 提示工程结果显示，大多数方法只在特定领域有效，因此这些方法并不能在每个数据集上都超过基线。
support_quote: Most methods are effective for special fields, so these methods can not surpass the baseline in every dataset.
title: PromptBench: A Unified Library for Evaluation of Large Language Models

answer: PromptBench 可能无法覆盖所有评估场景，某些指标可能遗漏细微的性能差异，且框架效果取决于数据集和提示的质量与多样性。
support_quote: It may not cover all evaluation scenarios, and some metrics might miss nuanced performance differences. The framework’s effectiveness depends on the quality and diversity of datasets and prompts.
title: PromptBench: A Unified Library for Evaluation of Large Language Models
